research_goal: under sparse causal sensing, optimize and calibrate the 10-minute supervisory move actually committed before replanning so system-wide cumulative TFV is reduced reliably within a 600-second RTC cycle; Priority8 PFV and Global Peak are secondary report-only outcomes

core_pipeline.step1: causal sparse sensors -> current full-network hydraulic reconstruction
core_pipeline.step2: causal state + causal rainfall + HOLD reference/candidate H360 action -> predicted delta TFV
core_pipeline.sequence_support: D3 TrainFit q95 joint temporal trust region prevents continuous optimizer extrapolation
core_pipeline.coordinated_direction: all-109 screening plus support-contracted H120/H360 V6/V7 optimizer supplies a system-level control direction
core_pipeline.first_move_refinement: optimize independent shrink factors only on facilities changed by the supported V6/V7 first move; execute H10 then HOLD_ACTIVE_TARGET H350; refinement cannot expand outside the upstream supported direction
core_pipeline.first_move_admission: fresh Development authoritative SWMM labels the same refined first-move query; 90% rainfall-group split conformal uses residual/sqrt(actual first-move changed-facility count), with at least 24 rainfall groups
core_pipeline.runtime: execute only when refined first-move predicted delta TFV plus its action-density-normalized margin is negative; re-observe after 10 minutes
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline calibration/evaluation only; never inside online candidate search

action_contract.engineering_bounds: physical min/max plus <=0.5 setting movement per 10-minute update
action_contract.per_facility_support: TrainFit q95 first-move and sequence magnitude
action_contract.joint_temporal_support: D3-HOLD q95 first-block L1, H120 L1 and H120 temporal total variation

scientific_bottleneck.evidence: V10 screened all 109 facilities and still found 51-69 predicted-beneficial facilities with 13-23 proposed first-move changes, yet admission passed 0/198 decisions. The final 25005.62 m3 prefix margin was larger than the optimizer's typical 0.07-4.49k m3 predicted prefix benefit, while exact SWMM replay showed 15/18 rejected plans were truly beneficial. V10 also calibrated only ten 23-facility prefix queries although runtime first moves varied from 13 to 23 facilities.
scientific_bottleneck.mechanism_under_test: whether directly refining the supported H10 move and calibrating uncertainty on that exact optimizer query with a larger, density-normalized fresh rainfall panel restores action availability without reintroducing false-beneficial actions
scientific_bottleneck.next_test: build at least 24 fresh Development rainfall groups, label one refined first-move query plus HOLD per group with authoritative SWMM, calibrate normalized conformal admission, then test on new preregistered Development events

promotion_rule: on new preregistered Development events require nonzero but reliable actions, zero support/engineering/readback violations, event-level TFV non-inferiority to No-control, representative refined first-move SWMM replay with low false-beneficial rate, and transparent PFV/Global-Peak reporting; only then consider untouched Validation
